digest.component_or_area: bridge projects store and CLI/library/MCP surface
propositions: Store must record which tracker projects a store syncs and which repos each project's tickets belong to via .bridge_state/projects.json, separate from bindings.json and prev_snapshot.json to avoid diff issues when multiple repos use the same store.

resolve_project(ticket, mapping) implements tri-state rule: absent field returns legacy_default, explicit empty string returns None, set key returns the key; None means not synced and is the fail-safe default when legacy_default is itself empty.
bridge projects sub-verbs (list, set, remove) must be accessible through CLI, library (src/rebar/_lib_ops.py), and MCP with parity, where list is READ_ONLY and set/remove are write tools.
set --repos is required and set --repos "" stores empty list; set on existing key replaces repos list idempotently; remove of unknown key exits non-zero and mutates nothing.
Absent projects.json record reads as empty mapping with None legacy_default (fail-safe); malformed record raises; mapping writes leave bindings.json and prev_snapshot.json byte-identical.
Pinned help in bridge.txt and parser metavar both must name projects verb; cross-surface test asserts CLI, library, and MCP write and read identical record.
